definition: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day
description: A busy old-town square on a hot, sunny day. In front a young man in a white shirt and dark tie holds a box of noodles at a street food stall, where a cook tosses noodles in a steaming wok and flames flare up. Crowds of office workers in white shirts and dark suits queue and eat noodles around the stall. The view rises to show a stone clock tower whose clock shows exactly twelve o'clock, both hands pointing straight up, above the crowded square. The light is bright and the shadows are short.

taps.phrase: to hold a box of noodles
